protocol.claim: Exact residual reuse and threshold-aware cheap bounds preserve optimum and lexical ties; report decisions, factor work, overhead and unfavorable controls separately.
protocol.partial_domain: Every variable takes -1 (free) or each valid fixed value; direct component controls cover all partials.
protocol.cache_comparison: Same bounded component-solving procedure with max_entries=0 versus max_entries=256, plus ordinary default-off optimizer baseline; no cross-problem or cross-invocation cache.
protocol.cheap_comparison: Identical grouped/mini-bucket settings with cheap_bound_first false versus true; retained frontier bounds remain full deterministic bounds.

named_control_settings.cheap_control: unary[100,1] times contradictory binary triangle on variables1,2,3; natural ordering; group_size2; localcache0; mini_bucket_entries1
named_control_settings.unfavorable_cheap_control: one unary factor[5,5], so root bound equals the lexical-minimum incumbent

protocol.success_criterion: All exact answers and ties match independent enumeration; at least one named control saves search decisions or original-factor evaluations while all extra work and unfavorable cases are retained.
nonclaims: No K4 or K5 plaintext/authenticity result.
No representative cipher performance or universal improvement.
A zero objective is a feasible zero-score result, never proof of infeasibility.
No reserved O fixture, GPU execution or model tuning.
